name: Courser Eye
summary: Coursers roam the highlands of Stonetalon, where Courser Eye is gathered for a troll witch doctor's brew. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin wants many eyes for a concoction he calls forest magic.

sections.title: A Troll's Concoction
sections.body: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil mixes tribal brews at Malaka'jin to fight the night elves contesting the region. Stag eyes are common in voodoo and folk alchemy, yet Jin'Zil demands thirty courser eyes at once, far more than ordinary spellcraft needs. He mixes them with fey dragon scales, sap, and feline whiskers. The brew is meant for the night elf prisoners held in cages at the back of his den.

faq.answer: Courser eyes come from Antlered Coursers and Great Coursers in the higher reaches of Stonetalon Mountains, especially near Mirkfallon Lake and Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil need so many eyes?
aliases: what does jinzil do with courser eyes
faq.answer: Jin'Zil says a proper brew can never have too many eyes. He mixes them with parts from local animals for the concoction he calls forest magic.

faq.q: What happens when Jin'Zil completes his forest magic potion?
aliases: what happens to the prisoners in malakajin
faq.answer: Jin'Zil plans to use his forest magic brew on the night elf prisoners caged in his cave. What becomes of them is revealed when he carries out the experiment.

angles.text: As a troll, you know Jin'Zil's crude use of animal parts reflects a darker, practical side of troll alchemy and mojo craft against the Horde's enemies.
As a night elf, you may see the coursers killed to fuel a witch doctor's cruel experiments on captured night elves as an affront to your reverence for nature.
